latestVersion.changelog:
SEM performance optimization skill for startups and marketers launching or improving Google Ads or paid search campaigns.

- Provides a step-by-step framework to calculate baseline SEM performance (CTR, CPC, CPA) per ad group.
- Uses Google Quality Score benchmarks to identify and flag underperforming ads.
- Guides on keyword profitability filtering based on customer LTV and profit margin, ensuring sustainable acquisition.
- Includes methods to prune unprofitable keywords and prioritize budget to best-performing terms.
- Helps restructure ad groups for long-tail keyword expansion and suggests use of Dynamic Keyword Insertion where relevant.
